channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Israeli Fire Kills Palestinians in Gaza and West Bank
item.description: Israeli fire resulted in the deaths of seven Palestinians in Gaza and one Palestinian in the West Bank. In Gaza, rescuers reported that Israeli fire killed seven individuals. In the West Bank, an Israeli firing incident led to the death of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ambassador Asked Donor for $100,000, Associate Claims
item.description: An associate of Ambassador Kim Guilfoyle claims she asked him for $100,000, stating "No question it was a quid pro quo." The associate is identified as a MAGA donor. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Trial Begins for Man Accused in 2009 Student Murder
item.description: The trial has begun for a man accused of the 2009 murder of UNC student Faith Hedgepeth. Prosecutors stated that the suspect's DNA was found on a blood-covered rum bottle at the crime scene. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indigenous Elder Charged with Child Sex Assault in Sydney
item.description: A prominent Indigenous elder from Sydney has been charged with the sexual assault of a child. The arrest and charges were reported by Australian news outlets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sam Wood Detained After Failed Bail Application on Domestic Violence Charges
item.description: Sam Wood has been moved to a correctional centre after his bail application was unsuccessful. He had previously appeared in court in relation to domestic violence charges. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Arizona Candidate Reports Sexual Assault While Repairing Campaign Signs
item.description: An Arizona congressional candidate has reported being sexually assaulted while repairing campaign signs. She stated that the incident occurred while she was working on the signs. The candidate believes the attack may have been politically… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FDA Extends Safety Review of Abortion Pill, Drawing Criticism
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has announced that its safety review of the abortion pill mifepristone will continue into the next year. This decision has angered abortion rights opponents and is facing a court test. The FDA's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: FBI foils Mall of America terror plot, arrests suspect
item.description: The FBI has arrested a suspect accused of plotting a mass terror shooting at the Mall of America. According to the FBI, the suspect also planned to join ISIS. The FBI stated that agents sold the suspect an assault rifle as part of their… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Two Latvians Arrested at UK Military Airbase
item.description: Two Latvian nationals were arrested after trespassing onto a military airbase in England. Counterterrorism police are investigating the incident, which occurred at a base used by the United States. The specific details of the breach and… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Fort Hood shooter's execution to be livestreamed by Pentagon
item.description: The Pentagon plans to livestream the execution of the Fort Hood shooter, according to an official. This execution will be carried out by firing squad and is reportedly the U.S. Army's first since World War II. One Democratic Senator… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: US indicts Venezuela's Maduro and wife on torture charges
item.description: The United States has indicted former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife on charges related to an alleged torture conspiracy. The indictment, unsealed on an unspecified date, accuses the couple of involvement in the torture… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: TikTok Accused of Secretly Testing Safety Features on Teens
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James has accused TikTok of secretly testing safety features on teenagers. Separately, a report indicates that teen safety features on ChatGPT do not work. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Para Athletes Accuse Officials of Demanding Money for Slots
item.description: Indian para athletes have accused officials of demanding money in exchange for slots. One athlete alleged that officials asked for a 20% commission on cash awards. These accusations surfaced before the Asian Para Games. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Building collapses in Delhi's Seemapuri, seven injured
item.description: A building collapsed in Delhi's Seemapuri area, resulting in seven injuries. Among the injured was a pregnant woman who, while trapped under the rubble, managed to call her family for water. She later died in the hospital. The cause of the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Orders Enhanced Delhi Police Patrol for Women's Safety
item.description: The Supreme Court has directed the Delhi Police to increase patrolling and enhance measures for women's safety in the capital. The court ordered the verification of cab and bus drivers and the closure of specific establishments. These… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Kerala High Court Orders FIR Against Former CM Vijayan Over Corruption Allegations
item.description: The Kerala High Court has ordered the registration of a First Information Report (FIR) against former Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan and his daughter concerning corruption allegations. The court's directive mandates an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi Police Accused of Harassing Protesters at Jantar Mantar
item.description: Protesters at Delhi's Jantar Mantar reported being subjected to a "cat and mouse" game by the Delhi Police, according to one account. The reporting suggests the police engaged in actions that hindered the protesters' activities. Another… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Mumbai Lift Plunges Six Floors, 14 Rescued
item.description: A malfunctioning lift in a Mumbai building plunged from the sixth floor, trapping 14 people for approximately three hours. All individuals were subsequently rescued. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Toll Protest Turns Violent in Thrissur, Minister Intervenes
item.description: A protest against toll collection on the National Highway in Thrissur, Kerala, turned violent. The protest, organized by the UDF, was related to the incomplete status of the road. A minister intervened in the situation as it became tense. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Odisha Student Union Polls Cancelled Amid Violence, Allegations
item.description: Student union elections in Odisha have been cancelled following crude bomb blasts at a college, leading to its closure. The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) has alleged that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) favored certain candidates, violating… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: ICE agents shoot man in New York City with child present
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents shot a man in New York City while a 5-year-old child was present in the vehicle, according to Mayor Eric Adams. The incident occurred in Marble Hill. The mayor has vowed action and called… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Madras HC Upholds FCRA Rejection for Trust, Contrasts Religions
item.description: The Madras High Court upheld the rejection of the Kanzeon Public Charitable Trust's application for registration under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010 (FCRA). The court observed that Hinduism is inclusive, while Abrahamic… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: IndiGo Flight Lands Safely After Lightning Strike Damages Nose
item.description: An IndiGo flight carrying 110 passengers made an emergency landing in Lucknow after being struck by lightning at an altitude of 17,000 feet. The incident occurred during severe weather conditions, resulting in damage to the aircraft's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Sri Lankan Death-Row Prisoner Injured in Saudi Jail
item.description: Twenty‑four‑year‑old Sri Lankan Hindu migrant worker Anojan Sivarasa, who is on death row in Saudi Arabia after being sentenced for a Facebook comment, was injured in a physical altercation with a fellow inmate. Sri Lanka’s Foreign… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.title: Delhi Building Collapse Leaves Multiple Casualties
item.description: A five-storey building collapsed in New Seemapuri, Delhi. Reports indicate at least three deaths, including a pregnant woman and a child, with eight people injured. Rescue operations are ongoing, with several individuals feared trapped… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: US Suspends Tech Firms, Including Microsoft, From Green Card Program
item.description: The U.S. administration has suspended Microsoft, Infosys, TCS, Adobe, and Wipro, along with five other firms, from participating in the green card program. The New York Times reported the suspension of Microsoft from the green card… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: US Sanctions Indian Firms and Individuals Over Iran Oil Trade
item.description: The United States has imposed sanctions on two Mumbai-based companies, SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited, and five Indian nationals associated with them. These actions are part of a broader US… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi detained during opposition protest in Delhi
item.description: Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi were detained by Delhi Police during an opposition protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The protest, initially planned as a march by the INDIA bloc to Jantar Mantar… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 5.

item.title: ACP Accused of Harassment Promoted Amidst Allegations
item.description: An Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) accused of sexually harassing a female journalist has received a promotion and been given the charge of Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP). The allegations surfaced during a protest at… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Flydubai Jet Plunged 14,000 Feet in Under a Minute
item.description: A Flydubai passenger jet experienced a rapid descent, falling approximately 14,000 feet in about 30 seconds. The incident resulted in damage to the aircraft, attributed to extreme speeds, angles, and G-force loads. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 10 · Right 2.

item.title: Supreme Court Questions Shiv Sena Symbol Allocation to Shinde Faction
item.description: The Supreme Court of India questioned the Eknath Shinde faction's claim to the Shiv Sena party symbol, referring to the act of defection as a 'constitutional sin'. The court's query was directed at the legitimacy of allocating the symbol… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab Govt Challenges HC-Ordered CBI Probe into ED Letter
item.description: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ordered a CBI probe into a letter from the Enforcement Directorate (ED) concerning the Punjab Director General of Police. The High Court also reportedly reprimanded the Chief Secretary over a 'false'… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Steven Galloway Accuser Apologizes Before Defamation Trial
item.description: Days before a defamation trial was set to begin, an accuser of former University of British Columbia professor Steven Galloway issued an apology. The accuser expressed regret for her role in spreading allegations against Galloway, stating… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Fatally Shot in Fort Worth Home
item.description: A 49-year-old man was found shot to death inside his home in Fort Worth. Police have stated that the incident occurred at the residence. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Norway proposes temporary ban on AI smart glasses
item.description: Norway is planning to introduce a temporary ban on smart glasses, specifically mentioning Meta's camera-enabled spectacles, in public spaces due to privacy concerns. The government is preparing a bill to implement this restriction. These… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Prince Andrew Challenges UK Police Over Epstein-Related Searches
item.description: Prince Andrew is taking UK police to court to challenge search warrants and an arrest related to the Jeffrey Epstein case. He is seeking to have these actions "quashed". Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: American Man Charged Over Perfume Thefts at Singapore Airport
item.description: A 47-year-old American man is to be charged on Thursday in Singapore for a series of perfume thefts at Changi Airport that began in November of the previous year. The Singapore Police Force stated that the stolen perfumes were valued at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Former German Spy Chief Arrested for Suspected Treasonous Espionage
item.description: Gerhard Schindler, former head of Germany's foreign intelligence agency, has been arrested on suspicion of treasonous espionage. He is accused of passing secret documents and allegedly provided money for them. The arrest was made by German… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 13 · Right 0.

item.title: US Marine Arrested in Okinawa Woman's Killing
item.description: A US Marine has been arrested in Okinawa, Japan, on suspicion of murdering a woman. The arrest has fueled growing anger in Japan over the presence of US military personnel on the island. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Kashmiri filmmaker detained by US immigration authorities
item.description: Kashmir-born filmmaker Arfat Sheikh has been detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) for two weeks and is awaiting a bail hearing. The detention occurred in the US. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.
